definitions: To become unable to find one's way.
To be unable to be found.
To be defeated or to fail to win.
To be no longer in existence or to disappear.
To be so engrossed or absorbed in something that one is unaware of one's surroundings.
examples: The hikers were lost in the dense fog.
The game was lost in the final minutes.
Many ancient languages are lost to us now.
She was lost in thought, staring out the window.
